meta.source: The Herder paper prototype (Paper & ink): paper sheets, ink edges, pen circles, sticky notes and stamps inside a standard phone-app layout.

tokens.name: pine-500
tokens.usage: Pine, the primary ink: evergreen. Raw scale — UI uses primary, primary-soft, primary-edge.

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: Sage, the secondary ink: lichen and dry grass. Raw scale — UI uses secondary and the sage sticky note.

tokens.name: clay-500
tokens.usage: Clay, the accent and the pen: trail dirt and terracotta. Raw scale — UI uses accent and pen.

tokens.name: oat-500
tokens.usage: Oat, the paper: canvas and oatmeal. Raw scale — UI uses bg, surface and the text greys.

tokens.name: success-100
tokens.usage: Raw success step; UI uses the semantic success tokens.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Paper: the page behind everything. Warm oat in light, a near-black green notebook cover in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: A sheet on the page: cards, the tab bar, the composer, row hover.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fresh paper on top: inputs, buttons, sheets, receipts, toasts, received messages.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: progress tracks, disabled buttons, read-only fields.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline edge of a sheet; the line under a list. Decorative — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, taken slots. At least 3:1 on every paper.

tokens.name: ink-rule
tokens.usage: Ink: the ledger rule above a list, the edge and under-edge of paper labels (buttons, slots, segmented controls), toast edges, the double rule above a total.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Pen line between list items, dashed lines between receipt items. Decorative only.

tokens.name: note-rule
tokens.usage: Ruled lines under written notes (session notes).

tokens.name: margin-rule
tokens.usage: The margin line that runs down Today's timeline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on every paper (bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, sticky notes). 12:1 or better.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Second lines, metadata, captions, inactive tabs — on every paper and sticky note.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and hints on bg, surface, surface-raised. Not for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast rules).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Pine ink: the trainer's decisions (Approve & send, Save), selected segments and slots, links, section labels.

tokens.name: primary-edge
tokens.usage: The ink edge under a pine button or selected slot.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Pine wash (rarely used: progress and selection backgrounds in the base components).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Sage ink: what the app or AI did (auto-reply notes, AI-draft stamps).

tokens.name: secondary-edge
tokens.usage: The ink edge under a sage button.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Sage wash for the tonal sage button.

tokens.name: on-secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-soft and on the sage sticky note.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay ink: the one call to action per screen (Book, Pay, Sign, Send) and what's next.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: The ink edge under a clay button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Clay wash (tinted tiles for new inquiries).

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: The trainer's pen: circles, squiggle underlines and ticks drawn over the UI. Clay, so a mark reads as handwriting, not as a control.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 3px outline, 2px offset, on every control. Blue so it never reads as pine selection or the clay pen.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Stamp ink and icons for done: Paid, Booked, Signed, Deposit paid.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stamp ink and icons for needs action soon: Unsigned, Due Nov 6.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Highlighter under a detail the AI wasn't sure of.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner background; the highlight behind an unsure detail.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stamp ink and icons for failed or late: Overdue, Card declined.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: danger-edge
tokens.usage: The ink edge under a destructive button.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info icons and stamps: rescheduled, synced.

tokens.name: bubble-in
tokens.usage: Texts from the client (with a border edge).

tokens.name: draft
tokens.usage: The wash on a selected list row.

tokens.name: sticky-sage
tokens.usage: Sage sticky note: anything the AI drafted, waiting for review.

tokens.name: sticky-clay
tokens.usage: Clay sticky note: the trainer's personal note to a client.

tokens.name: sticky-band
tokens.usage: The faint adhesive band across the top 12px of a sticky note.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: The greeting on a home screen. One per screen; the name gets a pen underline.

styles.name: t-title-3
styles.usage: Small headings inside cards; dog names.

styles.name: t-amount
styles.usage: Money totals, under a double rule. Tabular figures.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Section labels above lists and inside cards, in pine ink (hd-overline). Sentence case — never uppercase.

styles.name: t-time
styles.usage: Times in the margin of a timeline or agenda. Tabular figures.

styles.name: t-quote
styles.usage: The trainer's own words: her note on homework, system events in a thread.

styles.name: t-body-lg
styles.sample: Stand far enough away that Juno notices dogs.
styles.usage: Homework steps and anything read mid-walk.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Hi Jordan — I have Tuesday at 10:30 open.
styles.usage: Body and messages. Written notes use 26px lines over a ruled line.

styles.name: t-body-sm
styles.usage: Second lines in rows and cards.

styles.name: t-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, row titles, field labels.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and captions. The smallest running text.

styles.name: t-stamp
styles.usage: Small stamps, set uppercase. Big stamps use 17px (30px for the one on a confirmation screen) at 0.12em.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; tab underline inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to label; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; card and sticky-note padding.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, slots, segmented controls, toasts, dog avatars.

tokens.name: size-tap-lg
tokens.usage: The main action in an action bar.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, with 12px above the icons so the pen circle clears the divider.

shadow.note: Paper sits flat; only floating things lift. Pressable things use a hard ink edge (in bundle.css), never a soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating sheets of paper: the up-next card, receipts, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky notes: lifted at the bottom edge, as if the corner curls.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press: buttons sink 2px onto their edge.
